title: Choose the page structure
question: A new hand, built for people who have never met you. They arrive from a flyer or a shared link and need to know who you are, what the mission is, and why they should follow along.

options.label: The zine
options.thesis: A folded zine introduces Ruben to someone who has never met him, with one spread per question a newcomer asks.
options.viewport: A cover spread. On the left, the tomato cover: 'HÉ, IK BEN RUBEN.' at display scale over a portrait in a flat block, with 'en ik ga naar Nieuw-Zeeland' by hand. On the right, a cream inside page with three lines on what this is and the 'Lees mee' e-mail field.
options.risk: A zine can look cheap and DIY; the spreads have to be crisp and print-sharp.

raised.raise: The line drawings carry numbered callouts (1 Ruben, 2 the base, 3 the lake) that explain the mission at a glance.
Page numbers are real navigation: 'p. 4 Bidden' jumps straight there.
One handwritten signature stamp on the cover shows a real person made this.

regions.label: cover: HÉ, IK BEN RUBEN + portrait

options.label: One sentence
options.thesis: One long sentence introduces Ruben clause by clause, and each clause opens into its own section.
materials: cream sections that open from the words
options.viewport: Tomato flood with 'IK BEN RUBEN,' huge and the next clause, 'en over 85 dagen verhuis ik naar Queenstown', set ghosted below. The 'Lees mee' field sits inline at the end of the line.
options.risk: Moving text can feel like a gimmick; every clause has to work as a plain heading too.

options.label: A week there
options.thesis: The mission shown as a real week in Queenstown, so newcomers see the work itself, not a slogan.
options.viewport: A tomato poster asks 'WAT GA IK DOEN?' over a mountain drawing. Below it, a cream sheet with a Monday-to-Sunday timetable (teaching, outreach, worship) and Ruben's handwritten notes; 'Volg mijn eerste week' sits as the sign-up on the right.
options.risk: It needs your real schedule; I'd mark the sample blocks until you confirm them.

options.label: Patent sheet
options.thesis: An invention exploded into numbered figures.
options.risk: Technical and cold for a personal story.
options.case: Newcomers want a person, not an invention.

options.label: Plate annual
options.thesis: Plates with registration marks and a signed stamp.
options.viewport: A plate with a half-off stamp.
options.case: About craft, not about the mission.
options.kept: One handwritten stamp as proof of a person.

options.label: Teletext
options.thesis: Numbered pages on a block grid.

options.label: Jacquard
options.thesis: Binary choices weave a gold bird.
options.viewport: A bird gathering in gold weft.
options.kept: Many small acts adding up to one picture.

options.label: Alien forest
options.thesis: A glowing forest that lights the path ahead.
options.kept: The path lights a step ahead of the reader.

options.label: Ebru
options.thesis: Floated pigment combed into one unique print.
options.risk: Decorative, adds gradients the world bans.
options.kept: Each visit's moment is one of a kind.
